verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु विरते रामे वचनमर्थवत् ।ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरे रामं प्रकृतिवत्सलम् ।उवाच भरतश्चित्रं धार्मिको धार्मिकं वच: ॥ २.१०६.१॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu virate rāme vacanamarthavat ।tato mandākinītīre rāmaṁ prakṛtivatsalam ।uvāca bharataścitraṁ dhārmiko dhārmikaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.106.1॥

translations.english: Rama remained silent after saying these meaningful words on the bank of river Mandakini. Then the Bharata, conforming to righteousness, replied in clear words to the virtuous Rama who was affectionate by nature.

verses.sloka: को हि स्यादीदृशो लोके यादृशस्त्वमरिन्दम ।न त्वां प्रव्यथयेद्दु:खं प्रीतिर्वा न प्रहर्षयेत् ॥ २.१०६.२॥
verses.transliteration: ko hi syādīdṛśo loke yādṛśastvamarindama ।na tvāṁ pravyathayeddu:khaṁ prītirvā na praharṣayet ॥ 2.106.2॥

translations.english: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubts.
translations.hindi: मन्दाकिनी के तट की ओर मंद मंद चाल से चलती हुई, कौसल्यादि रानियों ने राम और लक्ष्मण के स्नान करने का घाट देखा

verses.sloka: सम्मतश्चासि वृद्धानां तांश्च पृच्छसि संशयान् ॥ २.१०६.३॥
verses.transliteration: sammataścāsi vṛddhānāṁ tāṁśca pṛcchasi saṁśayān ॥ 2.106.3॥

translations.english: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubts.

verses.sloka: यथा मृतस्तथा जीवन् यथा ऽसति तथा सति ।यस्यैष बुद्धिलाभ: स्यात्परितप्येत केन स: ॥ २.१०६.४॥
verses.transliteration: yathā mṛtastathā jīvan yathā 'sati tathā sati ।yasyaiṣa buddhilābha: syātparitapyeta kena sa: ॥ 2.106.4॥

translations.english: One should accept life and death, vice and virtue equally. How can one be afflicted when he has gained such an intellect?
translations.hindi: देखो, हमारे अनाथ, लोकोत्तर कर्म करने बाले तथा (कैकेयी द्वारा) राज्य से निर्वासित श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और जानकी के स्नानादि करने का यह घाट है

verses.sloka: परावरज्ञो यश्च स्यात्तथा त्वं मनुजाधिप ।स एवं व्यसनं प्राप्य न विषीदितुमर्हति ॥ २.१०६.५॥
verses.transliteration: parāvarajño yaśca syāttathā tvaṁ manujādhipa ।sa evaṁ vyasanaṁ prāpya na viṣīditumarhati ॥ 2.106.5॥

translations.english: O lord of men, it is not proper for a person like you who knows the past and the future of human beings to feel distressed and lament over it.

verses.sloka: अमरोपम सत्त्वस्त्वं महात्मा सत्यसङ्गर: ।सर्वज्ञ: सर्वदर्शी च बुद्धिमांश्चासि राघव ॥ २.१०६.६॥
verses.transliteration: amaropama sattvastvaṁ mahātmā satyasaṅgara: ।sarvajña: sarvadarśī ca buddhimāṁścāsi rāghava ॥ 2.106.6॥

translations.english: O magnanimous Rama, your nature is divine and you are true to your promises. You are omniscient, allseeing and wise.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि पानी भरना छोटा काम है, तथापि इस ह करने से वह निन्द्य नहीं है । क्योंकि अपने बड़े भाई की सेवा करना प्रशंसा करने योग्य काय है

verses.sloka: न त्वामेवङ्गुणैर्युक्तं प्रभवाभवकोविदम् ।अविषह्यतमं दु:खमासादयितुमर्हति ॥ २.१०६.७॥
verses.transliteration: na tvāmevaṅguṇairyuktaṁ prabhavābhavakovidam ।aviṣahyatamaṁ du:khamāsādayitumarhati ॥ 2.106.7॥

translations.english: It is not proper for a virtuous man like you, who is cognizant in matters of life and death, to be overwhelmed by such insufferable grief.
translations.hindi: है अद्यायमपि ते पुत्रः क्लेशानामतथोचितः । नीचानर्थसमाचारं सज्जं कमं प्रसुश्वतुः

verses.sloka: प्रोषिते मयि यत्पापं मात्रा मत्कारणात्कृतम् ।क्षुद्रया तदनिष्टं मे प्रसीदतु भवान्मम ॥ २.१०६.८॥
verses.transliteration: proṣite mayi yatpāpaṁ mātrā matkāraṇātkṛtam ।kṣudrayā tadaniṣṭaṁ me prasīdatu bhavānmama ॥ 2.106.8॥

translations.english: When I was away from home, my meanminded mother committed a sin for my sake which I never wished. You may pardon me graciously.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर बडे बडे नेत्रवाली देवी कौसल्या ने दद्षिणाम् कुशो पर रखा हुआ और पिता के लिए दिओ हुआ इंगुदी का पिण्ड देखा

verses.sloka: धर्मबन्धेन बद्धो ऽस्मि तेनेमां नेह मातरम् ।हन्मि तीव्रेण दण्डेन दण्डार्हां पापकारिणीम् ॥ २.१०६.९॥
verses.transliteration: dharmabandhena baddho 'smi tenemāṁ neha mātaram ।hanmi tīvreṇa daṇḍena daṇḍārhāṁ pāpakāriṇīm ॥ 2.106.9॥

translations.english: I am bound by a bond of righteousness for which I am unble to slay my mother who deserves severe punishment for her sinful acts.

verses.sloka: कथं दशरथाज्जात: शुद्धाभिजनकर्मण: ।जानन् धर्ममधर्मिष्ठं कुर्य्यां कर्म जुगुप्सितम् ॥ २.१०६.१०॥
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ daśarathājjāta: śuddhābhijanakarmaṇa: ।jānan dharmamadharmiṣṭhaṁ kuryyāṁ karma jugupsitam ॥ 2.106.10॥

translations.english: How shall I, born to Dasaratha of noble race and righteous deeds, with the knowledge of dharma, do such a reprehensible and unrighteous deed?

verses.sloka: गुरु: क्रियावान् वृद्धश्च राजा प्रेत: पितेति च ।तातं न परिगर्हेयं दैवतं चेति संसदि ॥ २.१०६.११॥
verses.transliteration: guru: kriyāvān vṛddhaśca rājā preta: piteti ca ।tātaṁ na parigarheyaṁ daivataṁ ceti saṁsadi ॥ 2.106.11॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha, my father and preceptor, is godlike to me. Devoted to meritorious acts, he departed from this world in his old age. For this reason, I cannot reproach him (publicly) in this assembly (of men).
translations.hindi: मैं तो सममती हूँ कि, देवताओं के समान भोग भोगने वाले महात्मा दशरथ जो के योग्य, यह भोजन तो नहीं है

verses.sloka: को हि धर्मार्थयोर्हीनमीदृशं कर्म किल्बिषम् ।स्त्रिया: प्रियं चिकीर्षु: सन् कुर्याद्धर्मज्ञ धर्मवित् ॥ २.१०६.१२॥
verses.transliteration: ko hi dharmārthayorhīnamīdṛśaṁ karma kilbiṣam ।striyā: priyaṁ cikīrṣu: san kuryāddharmajña dharmavit ॥ 2.106.12॥

translations.english: O Rama, conversant with righteousness, will any one who knows the meaning of righteousness, do such a sinful act contrary to dharma and artha to please a woman?

verses.sloka: अन्तकाले हि भूतानि मुह्यन्तीति पुराश्रुति: ।राज्ञैवं कुर्वता लोके प्रत्यक्षं सा श्रुति: कृता ॥ २.१०६.१३॥
verses.transliteration: antakāle hi bhūtāni muhyantīti purāśruti: ।rājñaivaṁ kurvatā loke pratyakṣaṁ sā śruti: kṛtā ॥ 2.106.13॥

translations.english: There is an ancient saying that at the time of death, the intellect of people is deluded. By conducting himself in this way, king Dasaratha has proved it.

verses.sloka: साध्वर्थमभिसन्धाय ऺक्रोधान्मोहाच्च साहसात् ।तातस्य यदतिक्रान्तं प्रत्याहरतु तद्भवान् ॥ २.१०६.१४॥
verses.transliteration: sādhvarthamabhisandhāya ऺkrodhānmohācca sāhasāt ।tātasya yadatikrāntaṁ pratyāharatu tadbhavān ॥ 2.106.14॥

translations.english: Our father has trangressed righteousness due to anger or delusion or recklessness. Therefore, you may think over the matter prudently and set it right.
translations.hindi: राम के दिए हुए इस इंगुदी की पिठ्ठी के पिण्ड को देख, मेरा हृदय क्यों नहीं हजार खण्ड हों कर फट जाता

verses.sloka: पितुरपतनहेतुत्वात्तदेवापत्यत्वेन सम्मतम् ॥ २.१०६.१५॥
verses.transliteration: piturapatanahetutvāttadevāpatyatvena sammatam ॥ 2.106.15॥

translations.english: One who sets right the wrongs done by his father is a true son. Otherwise the son becomes just the opposite. (He is not a son to the father).

verses.sloka: तदपत्यं भवानस्तु मा भवान् दुष्कृतं पितु: ।अभिपत्ता कृतं कर्म लोके धीरविगर्हितम् ॥ २.१०६.१६॥
verses.transliteration: tadapatyaṁ bhavānastu mā bhavān duṣkṛtaṁ pitu: ।abhipattā kṛtaṁ karma loke dhīravigarhitam ॥ 2.106.16॥

translations.english: So be a worthy son and let not the sinful act committed by our father and condemned by men of wisdom be approved by you.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार के कौसल्या जी के वचन सुनतीं, वे रानियां महारानी कौसल्या को धीरज बँधाती, रामाश्रम में पहुँची और बहाँ राम को स्त्रग से नीचे आए हुए देवता की तरह, बैठे देखा

verses.sloka: कैकेयीं मां च तातं च सुहृदो बान्धवांश्च न: ।पौरजानपदान् सर्वांस्त्रातु सर्वमिदं भवान् ॥ २.१०६.१७॥
verses.transliteration: kaikeyīṁ māṁ ca tātaṁ ca suhṛdo bāndhavāṁśca na: ।paurajānapadān sarvāṁstrātu sarvamidaṁ bhavān ॥ 2.106.17॥

translations.english: Protect this entire kingdom, Kaikeyi, me and father, our friends and relations, citizens of the city and inhabitants of the countryside.
translations.hindi: उन्होंने देखा कि, राम सब सुखोपयोगी भोग्य पादाथों को त्यागे बैठे हुए हैं तत्र तो वे सत्र की सब्र अत्यन्त दुःखी हो कर, उक्षस्वर से रोने लगीं

verses.sloka: क्व चारण्यं क्व च क्षात्ऺत्र क्व जटा: क्व च पालनम् ।ईदृशं व्याहतं कर्म न भवान् कर्तुमर्हति ॥ २.१०६.१८॥
verses.transliteration: kva cāraṇyaṁ kva ca kṣātऺtra kva jaṭā: kva ca pālanam ।īdṛśaṁ vyāhataṁ karma na bhavān kartumarhati ॥ 2.106.18॥

translations.english: Where is the forest and where is kshatriya's duty? Where are matted locks and where is governance of the kingdom? It does not behave you to do such acts antithetical to each other.

verses.sloka: एष हि प्रथमो धर्म: क्षत्ऺित्रयस्याभिषेचनम् ।येन शक्यं महाप्राज्ञ प्रजानां परिपालनम् ॥ २.१०६.१९॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa hi prathamo dharma: kṣatऺitrayasyābhiṣecanam ।yena śakyaṁ mahāprājña prajānāṁ paripālanam ॥ 2.106.19॥

translations.english: O sagacious one, the primary duty of a kshatriya is to be crowned. This enables him to rule his subjects.
translations.hindi: ज्ञोद-पिश्म्‌ू । ( रा० ) २ देवताः इतिश्षुतिः सत्येत्यन्वयः | ( गो० ) ध्द | अयोध्याकाण्डे [बत ठीक ही कहा करते हैं कि, मनुष्य जो कुछ का है बह बह अपने देव और पितरों को अपण करता है ( श्रथात्‌ इंगुदी पिण्ड को केबल पिता ही को नहीं दिआ खल्कि राम स्वयं भो बही खाता है)

verses.sloka: कश्च प्रत्यक्षमुत्सृज्य संशयस्थमलक्षणम् ।आयतिस्थं चरेद्धर्मं क्षत्ऺत्रबन्धुरनिश्चितम् ॥ २.१०६.२०॥
verses.transliteration: kaśca pratyakṣamutsṛjya saṁśayasthamalakṣaṇam ।āyatisthaṁ careddharmaṁ kṣatऺtrabandhuraniścitam ॥ 2.106.20॥

translations.english: Will any kshatriya, setting aside his first duty, follow an uncertain course of piety which is contrary to his dharma and whose impact may be felt in a remote future.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर लक्ष्मण जी भी माताओं को देख, अत्यन्त दुःखी हुए और उन्होंने राम के बाद, धीरे थोरे अविरत सब माताओं को प्रणाम किआ

verses.sloka: अथ क्लेशजमेव त्वं धर्मं चरितुमिच्छसि ।धर्मेण चतुरो वर्णान् पालयन् क्लेशमाप्नुहि ॥ २.१०६.२१॥
verses.transliteration: atha kleśajameva tvaṁ dharmaṁ caritumicchasi ।dharmeṇa caturo varṇān pālayan kleśamāpnuhi ॥ 2.106.21॥

translations.english: If you so desire to follow the path of dharma acquired out of physical exertion, then bear the trouble of governing the four castes of the social order righteously.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार उन रानियों ने राम की पीठ की धूल पोंछी थी, उसी प्रकार उन सब ने शुभलैक्षणों वाले लक्ष्मण जी की पीठ की भी धूल पोंछी, क्योंकि लक्ष्मण भी भी तो महाराज दशरथ ही के पुत्र थे

verses.sloka: चतुर्णामाश्रमाणां हि गार्हस्थ्यं श्रेष्ठमाश्रमम् ।प्राहुर्धर्मज्ञ धर्मज्ञास्तं कथं त्यक्तुमर्हसि ॥ २.१०६.२२॥
verses.transliteration: caturṇāmāśramāṇāṁ hi gārhasthyaṁ śreṣṭhamāśramam ।prāhurdharmajña dharmajñāstaṁ kathaṁ tyaktumarhasi ॥ 2.106.22॥

translations.english: O Rama, you are the one who knows his duty. The knowers of dharma maintain that the life of a householder is the foremost among the four modes of life. How can you renounce it?
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सीता जी ने भी दुःखित हो, आँखो में आँसू भर, साँसों के पैर पकड़े और उनके सामने वे जा खड़ी हुई

verses.sloka: श्रुतेन बाल: स्थानेन जन्मना भवतो ह्यहम् ।स कथं पालयिष्यामि भूमिं भवति तिष्ठति ॥ २.१०६.२३॥
verses.transliteration: śrutena bāla: sthānena janmanā bhavato hyaham ।sa kathaṁ pālayiṣyāmi bhūmiṁ bhavati tiṣṭhati ॥ 2.106.23॥

translations.english: Being younger to you in knowledge, position and birth, how can I rule the earth when you are present?

verses.sloka: हीनबुद्धिगुणो बालो हीन: स्थानेन चाप्यहम् ।भवता च विनाभूतो न वर्त्तयितुमुत्सहे ॥ २.१०६.२४॥
verses.transliteration: hīnabuddhiguṇo bālo hīna: sthānena cāpyaham ।bhavatā ca vinābhūto na varttayitumutsahe ॥ 2.106.24॥

translations.english: I am a child, deficient in intelligence and virtue and even inferior in position. Deserted by you, I do not wish to live.
translations.hindi: हा ! विदेहराज़ की बेटी, Fi दशरथ की बहू ओर रास की धर्मपत्नी सीता--इस निर्जन वन में कैसे कैसे कष्ट फेश रही है १

verses.sloka: इदं निखिलमव्यग्रं राज्यं पित्र्यमकण्टकम् ।अनुशाधि स्वधर्मेण धर्मज्ञ सह बान्धवै: ॥ २.१०६.२५॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ nikhilamavyagraṁ rājyaṁ pitryamakaṇṭakam ।anuśādhi svadharmeṇa dharmajña saha bāndhavai: ॥ 2.106.25॥

translations.english: O one, conversant with righteousness rule unhindered this entire kingdom along with our relations inherited from our father.

verses.sloka: इहैव त्वा ऽभिषिञ्चन्तु सर्वा: प्रकृतय: सह ।ऋत्विज: सवसिष्ठाश्च मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रकोविदा: ॥ २.१०६.२६॥
verses.transliteration: ihaiva tvā 'bhiṣiñcantu sarvā: prakṛtaya: saha ।ṛtvija: savasiṣṭhāśca mantravanmantrakovidā: ॥ 2.106.26॥

translations.english: Let all ministers, subjects, and priests including Vasistha who are wellversed in Vedic hymns consecrate you here itself.
translations.hindi: तेरे मुख को देख, शोकारिन मुझे जलाए डालता है । जिस प्रकार काष्ठ को अग्नि दग्ध करता है उसी प्रकार दुःख रूपी रणि से उत्पन्न अग्नि, मेरे मन को बिल्कुल भस्म किए डालता है

verses.sloka: अभिषिक्तस्त्वमस्माभिरयोध्यां पालने व्रज ।विजित्य तरसा लोकान् मरुद्भिरिव वासव: ॥ २.१०६.२७॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣiktastvamasmābhirayodhyāṁ pālane vraja ।vijitya tarasā lokān marudbhiriva vāsava: ॥ 2.106.27॥

translations.english: After consecration, you too return to rule Ayodhya along with all of us like Indra who went back (to heaven), accompanied by Maruts after conquering all the worlds with his prowess.
translations.hindi: महारानी कौसल्या दुःखित हो इस प्रकार कह्‌ रही थीं कि भरत जी के बड़े भाई राम ने वसिष्ठ जी के पास जा, उनके चरणकमल स्पशे किए

verses.sloka: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकुर्वन् दुर्हृद: साधु निर्द्दहन् ।सुहृदस्तर्पयन् कामैस्त्वमेवात्रानुशाधि माम् ॥ २.१०६.२८॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṇāni trīṇyapākurvan durhṛda: sādhu nirddahan ।suhṛdastarpayan kāmaistvamevātrānuśādhi mām ॥ 2.106.28॥

translations.english: Discharging completely the three debts, to gods, to ancestors and to sages, subduing your enemies and gratifying your friends, you alone (have the right) to dictate me.

verses.sloka: अद्यार्य मुदिता: सन्तु सुहृदस्ते ऽभिषेचने ।अद्य भीता: पलायन्तां दुर्हृदस्ते दिशो दश ॥ २.१०६.२९॥
verses.transliteration: adyārya muditā: santu suhṛdaste 'bhiṣecane ।adya bhītā: palāyantāṁ durhṛdaste diśo daśa ॥ 2.106.29॥

translations.english: O my esteemed brother let all your friends be delighted today at your enthronement and your enemies flee in terror in ten different directions.

verses.sloka: आक्रोशं मम मातुश्च प्रमृज्य पुरुषर्षभ ।अद्य तत्रभवन्तं च पितरं रक्ष किल्बिषात् ॥ २.१०६.३०॥
verses.transliteration: ākrośaṁ mama mātuśca pramṛjya puruṣarṣabha ।adya tatrabhavantaṁ ca pitaraṁ rakṣa kilbiṣāt ॥ 2.106.30॥

translations.english: O best of men, wiping out all the censure on my mother, redeem our revered father from sin.

verses.sloka: शिरसा त्वा ऽभियाचे ऽहं कुरुष्व करुणां मयि ।बान्धवेषु च सर्वेषु भूतेष्विव महेश्वर: ॥ २.१०६.३१॥
verses.transliteration: śirasā tvā 'bhiyāce 'haṁ kuruṣva karuṇāṁ mayi ।bāndhaveṣu ca sarveṣu bhūteṣviva maheśvara: ॥ 2.106.31॥

translations.english: I beseech you with my head bowed low, show mercy on me and every one of our relations, like Maheswara showing compassion on all living beings.

verses.sloka: अथैतत् पृष्ठत: कृत्वा वनमेव भवानित: ।गमिष्यति गमिष्यामि भवता सार्द्धमप्यहम् ॥ २.१०६.३२॥
verses.transliteration: athaitat pṛṣṭhata: kṛtvā vanameva bhavānita: ।gamiṣyati gamiṣyāmi bhavatā sārddhamapyaham ॥ 2.106.32॥

translations.english: If you turn your back on my solicitations and set out for the forest I shall also go along with you from here itself.

verses.sloka: तथाहि रामो भरतेन ताम्यता प्रसाद्यमान: शिरसा महीपति: ।न चैव चक्रे गमनाय सत्त्ववान् मतिं पितुस्तद्वचने व्यवस्थित: ॥ २.१०६.३३॥
verses.transliteration: tathāhi rāmo bharatena tāmyatā prasādyamāna: śirasā mahīpati: ।na caiva cakre gamanāya sattvavān matiṁ pitustadvacane vyavasthita: ॥ 2.106.33॥

translations.english: Thus besought and propitiated by Bharata with his head bowed low and distressed, the virtuous lord of the world, Rama, firmly established in the words of his father, resolved not to go back to Ayodhya.

verses.sloka: तदद्भुतं स्थैर्यमवेक्ष्य राघवे समं जनो हर्षमवाप दु:खित: ।न यात्ययोध्यामिति दु:खितो ऽभवत् स्थिरप्रतिज्ञत्वमवेक्ष्य हर्षित: ॥ २.१०६.३४॥
verses.transliteration: tadadbhutaṁ sthairyamavekṣya rāghave samaṁ jano harṣamavāpa du:khita: ।na yātyayodhyāmiti du:khito 'bhavat sthirapratijñatvamavekṣya harṣita: ॥ 2.106.34॥

translations.english: Having seen the wonderful deternmination of Rama, people were, at once, anguished and delighted, anguished because he would not return to Ayodhya, and delighted because he was firm in his resolve.

verses.sloka: तमृत्विजो नैगमयूथवल्लभास्तदा विंसज्ञाश्रुकलाश्च मातर: ।तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं प्रतुष्टुवु: प्रणम्य रामं च ययाचिरे सह ॥ २.१०६.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamṛtvijo naigamayūthavallabhāstadā viṁsajñāśrukalāśca mātara: ।tathā bruvāṇaṁ bharataṁ pratuṣṭuvu: praṇamya rāmaṁ ca yayācire saha ॥ 2.106.35 ॥

translations.english: All the priests, the chiefs of merchant organizations and mothers who had their senses switched off and theif tears drained dry extolled Bharata for his words. All of them, reverentially saluting Rama, implored him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredsixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
